items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: So I come down and Ben was asking me, "What are you doing?"

ctx.x: Stuff, yeah. So now we get to talking on the street, and he like loves to walk up Broadway, at that time, anyhow. I walk with him, and he says, 'Look, you know what I'd like for you to do? I'd like for you to -- I was thinking you could get you a group together, I think about three pieces. Get

about four altogether. You and bass, piano and drums." He said, "Now, forget about the big bands. It's all over. Let me see what I can do for you." He said, "You've been a nice guy. I've been watching you for years. You always carried yourself nice and never got mixed up in the dope angle and you always tried to support your family. Let me see what I can do." At this time he's with Universal, with Ben Bart. So now he said, "Let me talk to Ben. Let me talk to Ben." So he called me and said, "Ben wants you to come…
